style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
motion_rule: he stands on a revolving stand that turns him a full circle in EVERY beat, never riding anywhere; the library flies AT the lens instead: books, pages and shelves stream past the camera every half second; ONE bat clerk swoops through the lens in EVERY beat; he throws his whole body into one big action in EVERY beat; new shot size every beat, the camera never holds; he fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in
character: a male spotted hyena in a tight waistcoat and a crooked bow tie, teeth bared, fur ruffled

props: ONE wooden abacus he tears out of the air at 0.70; ONE thick book the clerk shoves into his paws at 4.00, blank, nothing written on it

environment: a round sunlit library hall, tall windows, white daylight, shelves to the ceiling, books swirling in the air

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
